papers.title: Joint Flow-Matching Posteriors for Overlapping LISA Galactic Binaries
papers.summary: Flow-matching transformer learns joint posteriors for overlapping LISA galactic binaries, scaling to 15,653 sources and matching MCMC calibration.

papers.title: Reconstructing the depth of first interaction in extensive air showers from fluorescence detector profiles with a physics-motivated neural network
papers.summary: A physics-motivated CNN-decoder reconstructs cosmic-ray first-interaction depth from fluorescence profiles, reaching about 21 g/cm2 MAE for 10^19 eV protons.

papers.title: A Cross-Domain Simulator and Benchmark for Uncertainty Quantification in Global 21-cm Inference
papers.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, Accepted at the Sim2Science, NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary: A differentiable GPU hybrid model emulates global 21-cm signals and foregrounds, enabling fast calibrated inference across 100 injected realisations with 94 inside 95% bands.

papers.title: Luminosity function of millisecond pulsars in globular clusters from their gamma-ray emission
papers.summary: Simulation-based inference constrains a log-normal gamma-ray millisecond-pulsar luminosity function in 36 globular clusters, reproducing nested-sampling posteriors and scaling to joint fits.

papers.title: Performance of attention-based deep-learning models in Shack-Hartmann wavefront sensor measurements
papers.journal_ref: Proc. SPIE 14150, Adaptive Optics Systems X, 141505I (2026)
papers.summary: A custom Vision Transformer reconstructs Shack-Hartmann wavefronts from 3.5 million simulated Subaru pupil images, outperforming U-Net and MAP across subaperture configurations.

papers.title: World Models Are the Right Foundation for Simulating Mars Terraforming
papers.summary: Position paper argues physics-regularized recurrent state-space world models with JEPA-style latents and a MarsWorld benchmark suit Mars terraforming policy search.

papers.title: Predicting the Orbital Retention of Habitable-Zone Planets Following Stellar Flybys Using Machine Learning
papers.summary: An XGBoost classifier trained on N-body simulations predicts habitable-zone planet retention after stellar flybys with 0.90 accuracy and about 74 times speedup.

papers.title: Is the learner or the summary the limit? Auditing machine-learning energy reconstruction for air-shower arrays on KASCADE and GRAPES-3
papers.comment: 26 pages, 14 figures, 14 tables. Submitted to Eur. Phys. J. C. Code: https://github.com/SamarjeetMalik/summary-representation-limits
papers.summary: Audits machine-learning cosmic-ray energy reconstruction on KASCADE and GRAPES-3, finding gradient boosting near the Bayes-risk floor and station signals adding little.

papers.title: Probabilistic Inversion of Strong Gravitational Lenses with Flow Matching Priors
papers.comment: Accepted to the 9th Annual Workshop for Machine Learning & the Physical Sciences (ML4PS), 2026
papers.summary: Blind-FlowSGS uses flow-matching priors for blind posterior sampling of strong gravitational lenses, outperforming diffusion methods on simulated Euclid data.

papers.title: Neural-Network Approximators for Low-Thrust Multi-Asteroid Rendezvous Optimization
papers.summary: Neural-network approximators predict low-thrust transfer capacity and propellant use, improving beam-search multi-asteroid rendezvous mission design by up to 17.8%.
